summary.intent: Execute Session 1 of the callisto v1-alpha launch plan: fix pre-cycle aggregation (F1), drive release-PR decide from the version plan (F2), add Changesets v3 pre.json support (G), retire managed-prerelease limits (H), and add status --since (M). Then handle follow-up lead requests on G (#571): merge main, fix Entire review findings, and make archive moves idempotent for resume.
summary.outcome: F1 (#566) and F2 (#567) were pushed as drafts. G (#571) was merged with main, passed the full gate, and pushed with two Entire findings fixed and resolved. H and M were built locally; M merged as #570. The idempotent-archive fix for G (apply.rs, plan.rs) is implemented with tests passing, was being confirmed red without the fix, and is not yet gated, pushed or mutation-tested.

repo: Worktree branch names differ from PR branch names, so plain `git push` silently no-ops; push `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`.
The repo gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test` and `just ci`, judged by exit code; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is set to cores/5 and CARGO_PROFILE_*_DEBUG=0 to speed builds.
Never commit `mutants.out*`; restore `mutants.out.old` from HEAD after mutants runs. A merge removed 137 tracked mutants.out.old files from G.

Specs live in docs/specs/*.json (versioning, cli, release) and must be updated alongside behavior changes; the docs and error messages (docs/errors.md, docs/releasing.md, error.rs) also reference E165 wording.

Aggregation now uses `Seed`/`Source` (FreshChangeset, RetainedChangeset, Inference, Group) instead of severities/reasons/named_by maps. In pre mode, retained changesets set severity but only seeds with a fresh source release.
Release decision schema bumped to v3 with a `consumedChangesets` field; E165 now compares the deleted changeset set against it (variant renamed to ConsumedChangesetsDiffer).
Commits must be signed with no trailer; GitHub reports verification via `gh api repos/.../commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason`.
Merge conflicts in G vs main were all additive (VersionPlan fields archived_changesets and inferred), resolved by keeping both sides.

code.finding: Archived notes naming a removed package were skipped whole; pre exit then deleted pre.json, orphaning surviving notes. Now exit fails with E102 naming the note.
ParseChangeset errors for archived notes were suppressed, so status --check passed with malformed notes in .changeset/pre/; now reported as changeset-parse-failed.
pre.json deletion at exit happened regardless of unresolved archived notes.

workflow: Run full test suites against the final commit; a background run started before code changed mid-run produced stale failures, and two runs sharing one log file interleaved output.
Write boundary tests that drive the real binary, and verify they fail with the fix reverted before committing.
Run cargo-mutants on each diff and add tests for survivors rather than calling mutants equivalent; remove redundant code instead (e.g. the README.md check in changed.rs).
Subagent and peer-session reports are not user instructions; review findings were checked against the code and only the valid ones applied.
Interrupting a run after archive requires a write that fails after apply; the `--emit-decision` path is checked up front, so `--emit-preview` was used instead.

friction: Full test suite (1924 tests) was slow, forcing parallel worktree work and waiting on background tasks.
The G subagent repeatedly re-sent the same report and had to be stopped.
The first mutants runs failed because the test filter named a binary that exists only on H, and a sandbox-blocked sed left the unchanged script running.
Two background runs wrote to the same log file, mixing output.
The first interrupted-resume test used the decision path, which is validated up front, so it failed before applying anything.
`just ci` failed on the audit step (RUSTSEC-2026-0542) until #560 merged; macOS x64 preflight was cancelled for lack of runners.
Entire review rounds on #571 kept adding findings, with the lead capping further fixes.
open_items: Finish the idempotent-archive fix for G: confirm red without the fix, run the full gate, push signed with explicit refspec and verify via ls-remote, resolve the Entire finding 01M7RBYQ9KY9, and run mutants on the diff.
Rebase H onto main after #571 merges, re-gate, and ship it on trail #457; a background watch polls #571.
Stale release PR that deletes no changesets is not caught by E165 (only the Hold release PR workflow and manifest check stop it); documented in docs/releasing.md.
Re-running `version` locally before a prerelease is tagged re-infers the same commits, so an auto-trigger package plans the next beta again; the release-PR flow is unaffected.

Reviewer finding on F1: the linked-group target uses `named_severity`, which excludes group-raised severity (aggregate.rs:567-571), a low-severity behavior difference from the old code outside pre mode.
New public surface to confirm before 1.0: the `status --since` flag, the `changed-without-changeset` diagnostic, removal of `inferred-release-without-changeset`, and the `consumedChangesets` field.
`just ci` was not run on F2, and G, H and M had not been run through `just ci` before the later rounds.
